definitions.name: Satisfiable
definitions.value: fun f => ∃ a : Nat → Bool, B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalCNF a f = true

statement: ∀ (f : CNF), Satisfiable f ↔ ∃ b : Nat → Bool, B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.evalCNF b f = true ∧ (∀ n : Nat, n ∉ B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.cnfVars f → b n = false)
proof:
by
  intro f
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
    let b : Nat → Bool := fun n => if n ∈ B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.cnfVars f then a n else false
    have same : ∀ n : Nat, n ∈ B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.cnfVars f → a n = b n := by
      intro n hn
      simp [b, hn]
    have equal := B_2199be74880768cf37366356ae1701e8f3582928f2bd55dce8ea5041d5596e00.result f a b same
    refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← equal]
      exact ha
    · intro n hn
      simp [b, hn]
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hout⟩ := h
    exact ⟨b, hb⟩
